test.name: Too-many-results: use includeFacets then scope to facet-derived collectionId
test.description: A broad keywords search for Flynn returns 847 total results plus facet collection breakdowns. The skill should use includeFacets on the first call, then scope a follow-up call to a facet-derived collectionId. Tests the too-many-results boosting ladder from search-strategies.md and the safe includeFacets scoping pattern from query-syntax.md.

input.user_message: Search the full-text index for Thomas Flynn in Pennsylvania land records. There are likely many results — please start with includeFacets: true to see collection breakdowns, then narrow to the most relevant collection on a follow-up call using the collection ID from the facets.

judge_context: The first fulltext_search call returns 847 total results plus a facets array. The user explicitly asked for includeFacets: true on the first call. A skill that ignores this instruction and does not send includeFacets on its first call scores PARTIAL on Query construction.

The facets show two collections: Pennsylvania Land Records (623 results, filterParam 2220359) and Pennsylvania Wills and Probate Records (224 results, filterParam 2017696). The skill should pick one and scope the follow-up call using that filterParam as the collectionId.

QUERY-CONSTRUCTION GRADING NOTE: The follow-up call's collectionId MUST come from the facets returned by the first call — this is the safe scoping pattern. If the skill uses a collectionId that was NOT present in the facets (i.e., borrowed from elsewhere), that scores FAIL on collection scoping per rubric. A skill that narrows only by adding boost terms (without a collectionId) is acceptable but scores PARTIAL since the user explicitly requested the facets-scoped approach.
The scoped follow-up returns 12 results from Pennsylvania Land Records — the skill should triage these against Thomas Flynn's identity using names, dates, and places in the result stubs.

RESULT TRIAGE: The scoped results include both Flynn-as-witness and Flynn-as-principal records. The skill should note which records name Thomas Flynn directly (as opposed to other family members) when triaging match quality.
